boundary: This is an externally bounded synthesis of public requirements and published AI-development principles, not a claim about a proprietary Lockheed Martin defect, bottleneck, architecture, or internal deployment.
statement: A publicly supportable engineering problem is integrating and operationalizing agentic AI/ML across disparate Space software systems while preserving repeatable traceability, reliability, explainability, model monitoring, testability, and CI/CD discipline.
